observed_structure: implicit_gemm_conv_2d selects convolution-specific input and weight loader types, fixes the BlockMMA transpose configuration, and allocates separate threadgroup operand tiles.
The kernel swizzles the threadgroup grid, guards the resulting output tile, applies group and convolution-specific address offsets, and constructs both loaders and the BlockMMA object.
Each gemm_k_iterations step executes a threadgroup-memory barrier, calls load_unsafe once on each loader, executes a second threadgroup-memory barrier, and calls mma on the staged tiles.
After each mma the kernel advances both loaders; after the loop it executes a mem_none barrier and stores the edge-shaped result through store_result_safe.
variant_notes: Input and weight loader selection retains small-channel and filter-size specializations together with grouped, spatial-window, and swizzled-grid addressing; none is normalized into the common recurrence.
The cited kernel has no explicit generic K-remainder branch and calls load_unsafe in every full iteration before a terminal safe result store.
The load_unsafe and store_result_safe names do not prove convolution-window bounds, zero fill, barrier participation, race or deadlock freedom, or memory safety.
